segments.name: North America
segments.description: Protective packaging and end-of-line automation business serving distributors and end-users from Ranpak's Ohio, Missouri, Nevada and Connecticut operations.
segments.evidence: The North America segment primarily consists of amounts earned from sales from our PPS and Automation products from our operations in Ohio, Missouri, Nevada, and Connecticut.

segments.name: Europe/Asia
segments.description: Protective packaging and end-of-line automation business serving distributors and end-users from operations in the Netherlands, the Czech Republic and Malaysia.
segments.evidence: The North America segment primarily consists of amounts earned from sales from our PPS and Automation products from our operations in Ohio, Missouri, Nevada, and Connecticut, and the Europe/Asia segment primarily consists of amounts earned from sales from our PPS and Automation products from our operations in the Netherlands, the Czech Republic and Malaysia.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and end-users pay a recurring per-unit user fee for Ranpak's PPS systems and buy the high-margin paper consumables that work exclusively with them.
revenueModel.evidence: Our PPS business utilizes a razor/razor-blade model where our proprietary PPS systems are provided to our distributors and end-users for a recurring nominal user fee, charged on a per-unit basis, and are coupled with the sale of high-margin value-added paper consumables that work exclusively with our PPS systems.
